clauses.anchor: Report 1 s3: `LinGe.Merge(dest, source, ...)` leaves `source` unchanged and copies accepted table/array values recursively
Report 1 s4-5: case-insensitive matching with exact-key precedence; preserve destination spelling and existing nested table identity
Report 1 s6-7: unrecognised keys ignored unless reserveKey; keep integer-to-bool conversion and the typeMatch=false replacement behaviour
Report 2 s2-3: a table keyed by exactly `0..n-1` (integers or canonical decimal strings) merges into an array in numeric order; empty tables mean empty arrays
Report 2 s4: sparse, negative, noncanonical, duplicate or nonnumeric indexes leave the destination array unchanged without rejecting valid siblings
Report 2 s5: reconstructed nested values do not alias the source
Report 3 s1-2: `ConfigManager.LoadAll`/`SaveAll` recover from an absent or malformed file (including a non-table root) to the registered values and write a valid file
Report 3 s3: loading updates registered tables in place, obeys reserveKey per section and never registers an unknown file section
Report 3 s4-5: bulk and single-section saves preserve unrelated sections; single-section Load/Save share the malformed-root recovery
Report 4 s2-3: each `LinEventTrigger` runs the callback list captured when it begins; changes affect later (including nested) invocations only
Report 4 s4: preserve duplicate registrations, prepend order, `callOf` binding, forward/reverse unhooking, return values and the public Hook/UnHook/Index/Trigger APIs
Report 5 s2-3: each dispatch deep-copies the caller's payload; subscribers share edits until RESET, which restores the original for later subscribers
Report 5 s4-5: nested dispatches are isolated from their parent; ACTION_STOP stops only its own invocation; null payloads remain valid
Report 6 s2: delayed events capture their payload when queued but select subscribers when the delay expires; two queued events stay independent

known_issues: benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-linge-director-state-hard/tests/verify.py:parse_results: the suite is one server boot. A missing or non-unique FINAL marker, or conflicting duplicate case markers, raises SubmissionFailure before any case line is printed, so every case is unobserved and the evaluator reports an incomplete (not a failing) result.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-linge-director-state-hard/tests/verify.py:collect_server: boot plus suite must reach FINAL within SUITE_DEADLINE_SECONDS (240 s since 2026-09-24, previously 55 s) of wall time; the suite itself needs about 7 s of engine time, so this is a slow-host limit, not an assertion. A missed deadline is an incomplete run.
Merge/config/event cases are Squirrel VM-level API tests inside the real server; they do not simulate a campaign or measure Director spawn frequency (task NOTES.md).
